purpose: Follow what circumstances, instructions, or impulses dictate.
keywords: V dictionary / V passive / Nの + ままに
I went into the back room as I was guided.
Let us choose colors as our hearts suggest.
I wrote words on paper as they came to me.
formation: V dictionary / V passive / Nの + ままに
restrictions: Conveys yielding to a direction or doing freely as prompted.
mistake: Distinguish from a state left unchanged, as in 開けたまま.
